issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task description) refers to a Farm method named printFarmSong(), but both the template and the solution implement and call singFarmSong() instead. This identifier mismatch (printFarmSong vs. singFarmSong) can confuse students about which method to implement or call and may lead to attempts to add a duplicate method or to failing to find the expected method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Either: (A) change the problem statement (UML and tasks) to refer to singFarmSong(), or (B) rename the template and solution methods from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (and update any calls, e.g. in Main and singFarmSongVerse references). This ensures students clearly know which method to implement/call.
